The United States Space Force (USSF) at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base is searching for a Modeling & Simulation Production Manager to support the National Space Intelligence Center (NSIC), (GG-0132-13). This position is covered by the Defense Civilian Intelligence Personnel Systems (DCIPS).

For additional information about DCIPS, click here: https://dcips.defense.gov/ Description: Are you a dynamic, high-caliber, technical production manager ready to safeguard critical intelligence and directly shape the nation's security?

The National Space Intelligence Center (NSIC) is the US Space Force's premier authority on foreign space capabilities and threats. We deliver game-changing, predictive scientific and technical intelligence (S&TI) that empowers joint force warfighters, national leaders, and defense acquisition professionals.

As we rapidly scale our mission capabilities, we are seeking a proactive, visionary Production Manager to pave the way. In this high-impact role, you will work in tandem with NSIC squadrons that drive our Modeling & Simulation (M&S) production planning and prioritization framework.

You will become a trusted mission partner at the forefront of space intelligence, coordinating internally and externally with influential agencies such as Space Systems Command (SSC) and the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA). If you are an articulate results-driven professional, your next mission starts here.

Ideal Candidate: The ideal candidate is a proactive, systems-thinking professional who operates effectively at the critical intersection of threat intelligence analysis (Red) and operational capabilities (Blue).

Beyond traditional production management, you will serve as a vital Mission Integrator possessing deep space domain familiarity and the technical acumen required to prioritize sophisticated Modeling & Simulation (M&S) frameworks.

You will work in tandem with the model-producing squadrons to manage requests, prioritize production, and provide production progress transparency.

You will stand out if you have the ability to work independently; plan, organize, manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines and expertly oversee joint production and federation plans while actively connecting and engaging with committee members.

Bringing a blend of expertise involving fundamental Modeling & Simulation knowledge, governance, standardization, and a self-motivated drive to build bridges across NSIC, external modeling agencies, and the intelligence and defense communities is also highly desirable Key Areas of Expertise - Proven track record of aligning diverse mission partners around common operational goals and fostering interagency cooperation, overseeing joint production and federation plans, and actively connecting and engaging with committee members. - Proven ability to define, translate, and implement complex M&S governance and standards established by the broader USSF enterprise, ensuring our frameworks remain aligned and compliant.

Experienced with friendly force ("Blue") and/or threat (Red) modeling architecture and requirements, methodologies such as Signature and Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) principles - Experienced in directly translating complex technical requirements into actionable production needs. - Possess a strong working knowledge of the operational structure and mission areas of the United States Space Force (USSF), paired with a deep understanding of the NSIC M&S mission set. - Possess exceptional executive presence with demonstrated experience briefing and advising DoW senior leadership and senior civilian counterparts. - Ability to operate with high autonomy in fast-paced environments-effectively prioritizing tasks, managing shifting deadlines, and driving project velocity amidst fluid mission requirements. - Superior verbal and written communication skills utilized to facilitate complex agency coordination, negotiate sensitive technical parameters, and reconcile competing priorities with production submission.

As a Freelance Sports Production Manager (360° Immersive) , you are responsible for planning, steering and operationally delivering immersive sports productions at L1VE – from the first project outline to successful on-site execution. The role is remote-first within Europe, with regular on-site presence at productions and optional use of our Berlin office.
Your focus is to manage clear, reliable production processes across departments. You combine strong operational execution with a sharp eye for quality, budget and timing. You understand how live sports productions work – and you make sure they are not only running, but delivered at an excellent level: every time, under new conditions, in new venues, with new requirements.
As a freelancer, you typically support one or several productions in parallel, depending on project scope and timelines.

Own the planning, coordination and on-site execution of immersive sports productions – from site visits and briefings to detailed production planning and delivery on location.
Take end-to-end responsibility across the full production lifecycle: timelines, budgets, quality standards and smooth operations are in your hands.
Coordinate and lead cross-functional teams across Tech, Content & Creation, Brand Partnerships and Post-Production under your project responsibility.
Oversee production logistics, resource planning and crew scheduling in close collaboration with the Tech department and the Production Assistant.
Create, manage and monitor project budgets – you track costs closely and act early when things start to drift.
Identify risks early and develop pragmatic solutions – you remain calm, clear and action-oriented in dynamic, time-critical production environments.
Lead and support production teams on site through clear, appreciative and solution-focused communication – even when the pressure is high.
Work closely with internal stakeholders as an external partner, ensuring transparency on timelines, costs and dependencies across multiple parallel projects where needed.
Your profile
Experience & Expertise
At least 3 years of professional experience in sports production, broadcast production or live event production – you have independently delivered real live productions.
Proven experience in budget planning and budget ownership for production projects – you understand the gap between planned and actual budget and know how to close it.
Experience managing complex projects with multiple internal and external stakeholders – you keep all threads together without losing the overview.
Solid experience in production planning and control – from first cost estimates and robust timelines to final reconciliation with clear ownership.
Familiarity with PM and production tools (e.g. Notion, Asana, Google Workspace or industry-specific production software) – you use tools to create transparency, structure and control.
Strong understanding of the specifics of live sports environments: last-minute changes, high-pressure situations, many parallel dependencies – and how to deliver reliably despite them.
Ideally, prior experience working in a freelance or project-based setup, coordinating multiple clients or productions.
Personal Skills & Mindset
Strong hands-on mentality and high drive to execute – you don’t just talk, you deliver.
High stress resilience – you stay clear, solution-oriented and reliable when the heat is on.
Strong sense of ownership – you take responsibility and don’t pass it on when things get difficult.
Passion for sports and immersive entertainment – you don’t just want to manage productions, you want to actively shape the future of live experiences.
Empathy and excellent communication skills – you lead teams in an appreciative way through clear, structured and reliable communication.
Flexibility and willingness to work on weekends and evenings on site – live sports doesn’t follow a 9-to-5 schedule.

Degree or vocational training in Sports Management, Media/Event Production, Broadcast or a related field – or an equivalent qualification through proven hands-on experience in live sports production.
You are set up as a freelancer (self-employed) and can collaborate with L1VE on a project basis across multiple productions.
Very good English skills (at least fluent, ideally C1 level), written and spoken, – you communicate confidently with international production teams, partners and clients. German basic skills and additional languages are a plus.
Willingness to travel at least 50% of your time – you like to be where the production happens, not just in the office.
Why us?
The opportunity to shape immersive sports productions and production structures in an international, fast-growing tech and media company.
Close collaboration with interdisciplinary teams across Tech, Content & Creation, Brand Partnerships and Post-Production – from first concept to live delivery in the stadium.
Direct impact on innovative live formats, international productions and global sports partnerships.
Work with state-of-the-art 12K/3D/360° streaming technology and immersive platforms that redefine the live experience.
Flexible, freelance, project-based collaboration with the possibility to support one or several productions in parallel, depending on scope and availability.
Modern tools and a culture that values ownership, performance, innovation and bold ideas – on and off the field.
We offer a competitive freelance compensation depending on experience and project scope.

The Manufacturing Manager is responsible for manufacturing engineering across filling, processing, utilities, and material flow , as well as packaging engineering, process readiness, and operational support for Project Nuri, a Greenfield CPS Korea facility.
The role ensures that manufacturing and packaging systems are designed, commissioned, and operated to deliver safe, high-quality, and efficient production while meeting business, regulatory, and sustainability requirements.
This role works closely with Engineering, Operations, Maintenance, Quality, Supply Chain, PMO, and external suppliers.
Support design, installation, commissioning, and start-up of manufacturing systems from Concept design to operational readiness
Monitor project schedules, CAPEX utilization, and system performance
Manage Engineering firms, external consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders
Ensure manufacturing processes meet safety, quality, and business requirements
Support Project Nuri manufacturing readiness in alignment with overall site design principles and future operational requirements.
This is a senior individual contributor role with technical ownership and does not include direct people management responsibility.

Manufacturing & Packaging Design (Greenfield)
Support Concept, Basic, and Detailed Design phases for manufacturing and packaging systems in alignment with the Project Nuri master plan
Provide manufacturing and packaging input into filling and processing equipment design, line capacity, process flow, utilities (CIP, air, water, steam), and material flow from raw materials to finished goods
Develop and govern User Requirements Specifications (URS) for manufacturing and packaging equipment, including all critical-to-quality (CTQ) requirements
Ensure manufacturing and packaging designs are fit for purpose, scalable, and capable of achieving required production targets
Participate in design reviews with Engineering firms, OEMs, and suppliers

Support installation, commissioning, and start-up of manufacturing and packaging lines from mechanical completion through operational readiness
Identify gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities during commissioning and start-up phases
Support smooth transition from project execution to stable manufacturing operations
Capture lessons learned and contribute to updates of manufacturing and packaging standards and specifications

Ensure packaging materials and designs optimize operational performance while allowing for supplier manufacturing variability
Support development, optimization, and technical governance of the packaging supplier network
Lead or support packaging supplier technical visits, trials, and audits (e.g. SQS as required)
Act as a Packaging Subject Matter Expert (SME) for selected key packaging types based on plant needs and Global Packaging guidance

Provide technical support to filling, processing, and packaging operations, focusing on line stability, changeover robustness, throughput, and loss elimination
Support investigation and resolution of manufacturing issues related to process performance, filling accuracy, material flow, and utility availability, as well as packaging-related issues, through root cause analysis and corrective actions
Drive improvements in throughput, waste reduction, and process consistency
Ensure manufacturing and packaging processes meet safety, quality, food safety, and regulatory requirements
Value Creation & Sustainability
Lead or contribute to value creation projects related to manufacturing and packaging optimization
Support packaging sustainability initiatives including material optimization, waste reduction, and environmental performance
Track and communicate project progress, risks, and milestones with local and global stakeholders
Documentation & Stakeholder Coordination
Prepare and maintain manufacturing and packaging documentation and specifications related to process parameters, filling conditions, utilities requirements, material flow, and packaging performance
Monitor project progress, CAPEX utilization (manufacturing/packaging scope), and key deliverables
Coordinate with Engineering firms, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and execution quality
